responsibility: This file implements the runtime exception-handling engine for GNU Modula-2's mc-boot libraries. It owns exception blocks and handler nodes, records exception numbers and diagnostic text buffers, installs and removes per-exception handlers, raises exceptions through the active block, tracks whether execution is in an exception state and what source raised it, provides the default fatal catcher, and can configure base Modula-2 exceptions to throw into handlers, making it the core handler-stack and exception-state subsystem beneath M2EXCEPTION and M2RTS.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the runtime implementation for GRTExceptions: it defines the internal exception-block and handler structures, free lists, active exception state, raising/dispatch logic, and default catcher behavior, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GRTExceptions.h exposes only the opaque handle and callable API.
